title: Desktop icon launch error blocks the whole plasmashell interface
line: An error from opening a broken desktop icon no longer freezes the panel, Kickoff and the desktop until it is closed.
explanation: Folder View opens files with a KIO job whose UI delegate has no parent window. When the job fails (here: an empty .desktop file with no Type= entry), KDialogJobUiDelegate showed the error with the blocking KMessageBox::error(nullptr, ...), which is application-modal, so every plasmashell click (panel, Kickoff, clock, desktop menu) was ignored until the box was dismissed, with no hint why. The change shows the message as a non-modal KMessageDialog when the delegate has no parent widget, and continues the message queue when it is closed; dialogs with a parent window stay as they were.

commits.message:
KDialogJobUiDelegate: don't block the application without a parent window

A job error without a parent window was shown with a blocking message
box, which is modal for the whole application and froze all of Plasma
until it was closed. Show it as a non-modal dialog in that case instead.

BUG: 526959

media.caption: Pure master: with the error open, clicking Kickoff, right-clicking the desktop and clicking the clock do nothing
With the fix: same clicks open Kickoff, the desktop menu and the calendar while the error stays open
Kickoff clicked while the error is open: nothing opens
Kickoff clicked while the error is open: it opens
Clock clicked while the error is open: no calendar
Clock clicked while the error is open: the calendar opens
